description.value:
A natural weapon is armed, threatens normally, and does not gain iterative attacks from high base attack bonus. The printed Attack line identifies the primary weapon; remaining natural weapons are secondary, normally at -5 (-2 with Multiattack). Primary damage uses full Strength and secondary damage normally uses half Strength. The actor's linked Full Attack record is authoritative for number, order, and exceptions.

This reusable record defines shared conversion behavior. Individual actors carry exact printed exceptions and totals.

system.source: World of Warcraft: Monster Guide, pp. 193
